channel.title: RIPworx news
channel.description: Games for retro computers, made in Asunción, Paraguay.

item.title: Pothole Rush comes to the MEGA65.
item.description: In full color and edge to edge, with five landscapes, an icy road in the snow, stereo sound and a car radio with eleven tracks. For the MEGA65, and for Windows and Linux with the emulator included.

item.title: Pothole Rush: Version 1.0.2.
item.description: The perfect jump over a cone, wrenches that count the moment you touch them, and a game that remembers your name. On Windows and Linux, the arrow keys work as a joystick, and on Linux it no longer closes now and then as it opens.

item.title: Pothole Rush comes to Windows and Linux.
item.description: Installer, zip or AppImage: download and play, nothing to set up.

item.title: Pothole Rush: Version 1.0.1.
item.description: The wrench and the collisions, closer to the original, and the game version shown on the title screen.

item.title: Jumping Jim: Version 1.1.1.
item.description: It now recognizes the Drean, the Argentinian C64, and calls it by its name.

item.title: Pothole Rush: Version 1.0 is here!
item.description: One program for PAL, NTSC and Drean machines, your car in the color you choose, and a manual with a few words from Sebas and Carlos.

item.title: RIPworx: We have a new address: ripworx.dev.
Pothole Rush: Now on cartridge, too.
item.description: The EasyFlash cartridge starts by itself at power-on and saves your progress on the cartridge, no disk drive needed.

item.title: Jumping Jim gets its own page.
item.description: roman126's ZX Spectrum Next game, on the Commodore 64.

item.title: RIPworx is born.
item.description: The home of our games for retro computers opens with the first test version of Pothole Rush.

item.title: Jumping Jim: Version 1.1.0.
item.description: A different background on every level, a screen that shakes with every bump, and one program for PAL, NTSC and Drean.

item.title: Jumping Jim lands on the Commodore 64.
item.description: A port of roman126's ZX Spectrum Next game, with his permission, free and open source.
